name: Shanghai
summary: Shanghai is the largest metropolis in mainland China, a financial and technological center of futuristic skyscrapers along the Huangpu River, with excellent public transport and a significantly lower cost of living than other comparable global megacities. The big obstacle for the digital nomad is the Great Firewall: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram, Gmail and most Western tools are blocked and require a reliable VPN installed before arriving in the country, since the app stores and VPN websites are inaccessible once inside. China does not offer a digital nomad visa, so working remotely is usually done under a tourist visa, an ambiguous legal zone with no work coverage. In return, Shanghai offers ultra-modern urban living, world-class cuisine and a fast, cheap subway that connects the entire city.
